limitations: a block of a value-conserving mapping is an accounting unit, not a wallet
a collaborative transaction can place two owners in one block, so a forced pair is not an ownership finding
only transactions with at most max_coins coins are in scope, which excludes the wide consolidations and coinjoins where the question is hardest
the snapshot is 300 selected transactions and is not a chain-wide sample
fee tolerance admits mappings exact conservation would refuse, which can only widen the family and lower the forced share
the result is not a privacy score
